Local reporting indicates P4 is a multi-phase, mixed-product fab: PH1 was operating by November 2025 with NAND and 1c DRAM lines; PH3 had completed line construction and had equipment moving in; PH4 had entered groundbreaking; PH2 was expected to break ground in December 2025 or January 2026. A later local report says blanket front-end equipment orders for PH2 and PH4 were placed in March 2026. Samsung officially confirms commercial HBM4 based on 1c DRAM and says it is expanding HBM4 capacity using previously secured cleanroom infrastructure, but does not attribute that production or a WPM figure to P4 phases. The ProcessWindow planning baseline places PH3 HVM in 2026Q1, PH1 HVM in 2026Q2, PH4 HVM in 2026Q4, and PH2 HVM in 2027Q3; these are phase planning estimates and do not establish physical cleanroom identity.

SK hynix officially designated M15X as a new DRAM production base focused on next-generation DRAM including HBM, with construction targeted for November 2025 and production before Yongin's first fab. Detailed April 2026 local reporting says production was ramping at about 10,000 wafer inputs per month, targeting 30,000-50,000 WPM by year-end 2026 and a maximum 80,000 WPM in 2027. ProcessWindow supplies the current planning baseline: Phase 1 HVM in 2026Q2 and Phase 2 HVM in 2026Q4.

First-fab shell and cleanroom buildout are underway. SK hynix officially confirms two building shells and six cleanrooms, with the first cleanroom opening accelerated to February 2027. A local supply-chain report says a pilot/one-pass line is planned for February 2027 and equipment installation for an initial approximately 20,000 WPM tranche is expected in March or April 2027. Using the user-preferred ProcessWindow planning baseline, Phase 1 HVM is currently estimated for 2027Q2; this is a planning estimate distinct from the confirmed February cleanroom-opening target and reported March/April tool installation.
